questions.question: How many countries make up the United Kingdom?
options: Four: England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland
questions.explanation: The UK consists of four countries. Great Britain refers only to England, Scotland, and Wales.

questions.question: Which language is spoken alongside English in Wales?
questions.explanation: Welsh is a Celtic language spoken by about 20% of the Welsh population and is an official language in Wales.

questions.question: What year did the UK officially leave the European Union (Brexit)?
questions.explanation: While the Brexit referendum was in 2016, the UK officially left the EU on January 31, 2020.

questions.question: The British Empire at its peak covered approximately what percentage of the world's land?
questions.explanation: At its height, the British Empire was the largest in history, governing about a quarter of the world's land and population.

questions.question: What is the "Windrush generation"?
options: Caribbean immigrants who came to the UK after World War II
questions.explanation: The Windrush generation refers to Caribbean migrants who came to the UK between 1948-1971, named after the ship HMT Empire Windrush.
